title: Correct answer-only labels
description: Prompt tokens are ignored; answer tokens and EOS remain supervised. Try changing an observed label and run the check again.

title: EOS accidentally masked
description: The observed labels ignore the final EOS token (99). Change the last observed -100 back to 99 and rerun to check the repair.

title: Prompt included in the loss
description: The observed labels supervise prompt tokens too. Replace the first two observed labels with -100 to restore answer-only supervision.

title: Labels shifted twice
description: The observed labels have an extra shift before the model applies its causal shift. Restore the reference labels to remove it.
